decisions.reason: The software version management tool remains closely tied to the firm's hosting platform and automation strategy, so prior development effort and strategic fit make management likely to continue it despite uncertainty.

Although this contract tool sits further from the core hosting business, its separate product presence and multi-model line create enough sunk investment and public commitment that management would still be somewhat more inclined to persist than to withdraw.

Scalable hosting for agencies is a flagship, highly visible offer at the center of the firm's stated direction and customer focus, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on the market.
